# Feature description
> 2 to 3 sentence describing where this part goes and what does it serve

# Deadline
MM/DD/YYYY

# Requirements
- Is there a strict dimension that this part need to meet? if so, what?
- What other parts are going to interact with this new part(s)?
- How much force will be applied to this part? and from where?
- What are some failure point of this part when stress tested?
- How will this part going to mitigate these failure points?
- What should the tolerance be on each connection point? 

# Final part information
## Module
- [ ] Leg
- [ ] Hip
- [ ] Chassis
- [ ] Pneumatics

# File and weight
> copy if multiple

Part ID: #X
Part name in fusion: 
Estimated weight: XX.X lb
Fusion file location: XXX/YYY/ZZZ

# Test methods
> physical testing and assembly testing

# Rough design notes and decisions
> sketches, photos of parts, design ideas

# Review
Reviewer: ---
Last Reviewed Date: MM/DD/YYYY

Check list:
- [ ] Set deadline for CAD review
   - [ ] Update task description
- [ ] Establish engineering requirements for the part(s)
   - [ ] Loads
   - [ ] Dimensions
   - [ ] Weight
- [ ] Generate solution concepts
   - [ ] Identify key risks
   - [ ] structural solutions to those risks
- [ ] Create prototype CAD model
   - [ ] Fully constrain all sketches
   - [ ] Properly join all components in separate assembly
   - [ ] Ensure each part is printable and can be properly assembled
   - [ ] Tolerance all screw holes and other mating surfaces for 3D printing
   - [ ] Create Fusion Milestone
- [ ] 3D print the part(s)
   - [ ] Test engineering requirements(did it pass?)
   - [ ] Test assembly interactions(did it pass?)
- [ ] Updated [Part List](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Lz6Sw-Gd7orjvEfe1vMTaa1BJ5Jo_y5QtSiVIIQgiJI/edit?usp=sharing)
- [ ] Ask task for review
